title: Help on hover: a pop-up for every control on every page (what it does, what input it expects, whether it reads or changes the tenant), with its catalogue and coverage tests

coverage.how: V8 block coverage of static/hover_help.js across the browser tests (the file is new; 0 before). The catalogue is data: 1,236 entries, every one matched or checked for orphans.

checks.what: Every visible control on all 35 pages, toured on the sample tenant (tabs, folded sections, dialogs, Analyze / Read / Preview, the Build new forms, stored reports), has an entry with non-empty what and input
Focus on every such control opens the pop-up with its entry's words, beside the control, inside the viewport; aria-describedby carries the same words; no native title remains
Real mouse hover opens it; it is hoverable; leaving both closes it; Tab focus opens it and it persists; Esc closes it without moving focus
Touch: a long press opens it; the info target is 28x28 px, labelled, beside the control
Contrast of every line of the pop-up, dark and light theme, at least 4.5:1
At 320 px on every page, every pop-up stays inside the viewport and adds no sideways scroll
Reduced motion: no transition; normal: a 120 ms fade
Hostile catalogue text and a hostile native title render as text and never run; the engine has no HTML sink; the repo's sink scanner passes
No orphan catalogue keys: every id, class and attribute value a key uses exists in that page's sources
A new control without help fails CI with its page and selector named
The extension's popup, options and side panel load local, byte-identical copies; their controls all have entries; the catalogue holds no remote address or credential-shaped text
Write controls say they need write mode; the pop-up adds the four gates line
Plain words: average sentence length and Flesch-Kincaid grade of the catalogue bounded; long sentences only where the page's own wording is reused

findings.title: No control explained what it does or what input it expects on hover or focus (the owner's request)
findings.fix: Shared Help on hover engine and a catalogue entry for every control on every page and the extension

findings.title: Native title tooltips (about 150 controls) did not open on keyboard focus or touch and could not be dismissed with Esc
findings.fix: Titles converted into catalogue entries word for word; the engine removes the native title so one pop-up shows

findings.title: A field inside a label with a title (Client Connector installer options on /report/fleet) would show two tooltips at once
findings.fix: The engine also converts the title of the label around a control

findings.title: /help scrolls sideways at 320 px: the .xp-dl grid's 1fr column takes its longest word's width (362 px page)
findings.fix: minmax(0, 1fr) column and overflow-wrap on dt/dd at phone width (checked in the browser: 320 px page)

findings.title: /report/fleet scrolls sideways at 320 px: installer option labels are inline-flex rows that never wrap (343 px page)
findings.fix: Let the labels wrap and shrink (checked in the browser: 320 px page)

findings.title: The shared browser-test harness (test_findings_reflow.run_in_browser) leaves the in-app updater and restart live: a test that clicks Update now runs git against the developer's checkout (seen in this QA: a crawl switched the clone to main and stashed local edits)
findings.fix: Neutralise app_update.update and schedule_restart in the harness as tests/test_c6_tooltips.py does
findings.proposed_patch:
--- a/tests/test_findings_reflow.py
+++ b/tests/test_findings_reflow.py
@@ -197,2 +197,5 @@
     mp.setattr(srv, "_latest_remote_commit", lambda branch="main": None)
+    import app_update   # a toured "Update now" or "Restart" must never touch this checkout or process
+    mp.setattr(app_update, "update", lambda *a, **k: {"ok": False, "message": "disabled in tests"})
+    mp.setattr(app_update, "schedule_restart", lambda *a, **k: {"ok": False, "message": "disabled in tests"})
     server = uvicorn.Server(uvicorn.Config(srv.app, host="127.0.0.1", port=0, lifespan="off", log_level="warning", access_log=False))

findings.title: Some controls have no stable hook of their own (offline_tenant.js snapshot buttons, find_anything.js card buttons, pov.js intake fields and report buttons, flow_pages.js walk buttons, panel.js detail buttons, zcc_fleet.js details) so their entries use structural selectors or one entry per family
findings.fix: Entries exist and pass; adding ids would edit files owned by other areas. Suggested hooks are in this record's checks
